verdict.rationale: The OpenHands README states directly that users can create automations and workflows that run on a schedule, which is the recurring-job capability itself and not just a one-off action. Agent Canvas is described as a control center for automations, but the event-triggered watchers (label, Slack, failed-workflow) are separate from time-based scheduling. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on schedule configuration (cron syntax, intervals, managing or pausing schedules), and independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled runs work.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Create automations and workflows that integrate with Slack, GitHub, Linear, and more. Run on a schedule or in response to webhook events
Agent Canvas is the open-source browser client and control center for agent conversations and automations.
